skill.summary: Automate extraction, analysis, summarization, legal research, and deadline tracking of contracts and legal documents for law firms and professionals.

latestVersion.changelog:
LegalDoc AI 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces contract clause extraction supporting 12 common clause types
- Adds document summarization for contracts, cases, and regulatory filings
- Integrates AI-powered legal research (case law, statutes, regulation)
- Includes automated deadline tracking and alerts for legal matters
